title: Obtaining SCIM Group Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information on managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) SCIM group use cases using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of All SCIM Groups

blocks.text: To get details of all SCIM groups for the specified IdP ID:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimgroup/idpId/{idpId}.
Provide the following values in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
idpId: The ID of a particular IdP. To learn more, see Obtaining IdP Configuration Details Using API.
View an example response

{ "totalPages": "1", "totalCount": "2", "list": [ { "id": "20464", "modifiedTime": "1610781818", "creationTime": "1610626185", "name": "group 2 public api", "idpId": "73196561382768893", "idpGroupId": null }, { "id": "20463", "modifiedTime": "1610781110", "creationTime": "1610626168", "name": "group 1 public api", "idpId": "73196561382768893", "idpGroupId": null } ] }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
This API supports pagination and sort capabilities. To get a paginated response and sort:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimgroup/idpId/{idpId}?page=1&pagesize=5&sortBy=name&sortOrder=DSC.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint.
idpId: The ID of a particular IdP.
Valid values for page and page size parameters.
Valid sortBy string values (e.g., name).
View an example response

blocks.text: If not provided, the default page size is 20. The maximum page size is 500.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Getting Details for a Particular SCIM Group

blocks.text: To get details of a particular SCIM group:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /userconfig/v1/customers/{customerId}/scimgroup/{scimGroupId}.
Use the following values in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
scimGroupId: The ID of a particular SCIM group.
View an example response
{ "id": "20464", "modifiedTime": "1610781818", "creationTime": "1610626185", "name": "group 2 public api", "idpId": "73196561382768893", "idpGroupId": null }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
The following table includes descriptions of available fields for the SCIM group use cases:

table: Indicates the page. If not provided, the default value is 1.
Indicates the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.
Indicates the sortBy field name that is used to sort the results. If not provided, the results are sorted by modifiedTime.
Supported values: id name creationTime modifiedTime
